messages.content: 1.[Marcellus]My lord. Are yeh well? 2.[Hamlet]Of course I'm not well. How could I be? You were there! You saw everything! 3.[Marcellus]Perhaps you ought to lie down a while. 4.[Marcellus]Or 'ave a drink. Yeh know, I've a bottle of brandy from the year you were born! 5.[Marcellus]Prolly turned to shit by now, though. 6.[Hamlet]Leave me, Marcellus. Your kindness is wasted. 7.[Marcellus]M'lord, will you not even come to this morning's court? 8.[Hamlet]I don't think I can face him. Not after what I heard last night. 9.[Marcellus]But if yeh don't come... won't he be displeased? 10.[Marcellus]I knew yer father well. He always kept a strong face in times like these. 11.[Marcellus]An' so should you. 12.[Marcellus]Come, m'lord. I'll accompany you. 13.[Hamlet]So be it.

1.[Horatio]My Queen, these walks are a treat. Your beauty is so great that when people see us out, I look handsome just standing next to you.
2.[Queen Gertrude]Heh. You flatter me.
3.[Queen Gertrude]Say, Horatio...
4.[Queen Gertrude]I know nothing about you. Have you ever told me of yourself?
5.[Queen Gertrude]My late husband often spoke of your prowess on the battlefield. But what before that?
6.[Horatio]There's not much to tell, my lady. I'm but a poor footsoldier. Then I followed Hamlet to Wittenberg, for a time.
7.[Horatio]I didn't care much for the area, I'm afraid. No offense to your Bohemian heritage.
8.[Queen Gertrude]No offense taken. I consider myself Danish now. But where were you born?
9.[Horatio]Italy, your Highness.
10.[Queen Gertrude]Italy! What! So far from here? What is it like?
11.[Horatio]Italy is... hard to describe. Loud and hot, and at once, brimming with quiet beauty.
12.[Horatio]My father was a spice merchant in Venice, originally of Calicut. He sailed the route and took me with him often, when I was a boy. It was in Calicut he met my mother.
13.[Horatio]But their love was brief, her pregnancy was a secret, and they were unwed. After I was born, my father absconded with me to Venice to save her reputation.
14.[Queen Gertrude]How sad for your mother, don't you think?
15.[Horatio]I wouldn't know. I saw her just once or twice when I was a boy. She was married off to another man. After that, Father and I never saw her again.
16.[Horatio]But my father loved me dearly.
17.[Queen Gertrude]What of your life after that? Venice, India, Denmark—you've traveled perpetually.
18.[Horatio]Why, my lady, my secrets are the key to my charm!
19.[Horatio]It's just a lot of nothing anyhow. I far prefer my life these days. Venice holds certain painful memories for me.
20.[Queen Gertrude]I'm sorry to hear that. Well, regardless, I'm glad you're here.
</textarea>
